## TemplateEngine.validateBlockSwitchAttributes() method

Validates attributes on `<switch>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockSwitchAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

## Remarks

The only allowed attribute is `value`<!-- -->.

## Example


